entries.Original: Abort pending Peloton use during countdown
entries.Translated: 开始倒计时时取消待使用的速行
使用技能时选择战斗目标

entries.Original: Activates your tank stance automatically upon job switching or entering a dungeon.
entries.Translated: 切换职业或进入迷宫时自动开启防御姿态。
为物品箱添加“全部打开”

entries.Original: Adds a button to Aetherial Reduction to process all items.
entries.Translated: 在精选窗口中添加一个处理全部物品的按钮。

entries.Original: Adds a button to the bottom of the saddlebag to entrust duplicates.
entries.Translated: 在陆行鸟鞍囊底部添加一个按钮，用于存入相同种类的物品。

entries.Original: Adds a button to the desynthesis window to desynth all from the current dropdown. (Disclaimer: Pandora takes no responsibility for the loss of any Ultimate weapons or other rare items. Please use responsibly.)
entries.Translated: 在分解窗口添加按钮，用于分解当前分类中的全部物品。（请谨慎操作，Pandora 对误分解的绝境战武器等贵重物品概不负责。）

entries.Original: Adds a button to the extract materia window to start extracting all.
entries.Translated: 在精制魔晶石窗口添加一键全部精制的按钮。

entries.Original: Adds a context menu to items whilst the FC chest is open to quickly deposit them.
entries.Translated: 打开部队储物柜时，在物品右键菜单中添加快捷存入选项。

entries.Original: Adds a description of what stage a quest is for when talking to the NPC.
entries.Translated: 与 NPC 交谈时，显示任务当前阶段的说明。

entries.Original: Adds an "Open All" option to the right click menu of various items that stack and can be opened from the inventory.
entries.Translated: 为可堆叠且可从背包打开的物品添加“全部打开”右键菜单项。

entries.Original: Allows deciphering treaure maps from hotbar.
entries.Translated: 允许在热键栏上解读陈旧的地图。
任务结束后自动投最优队员
自动开启矿脉勘探或三角测量
自动召唤小仙女或宝石兽
自动同步临危受命等级
自动与副本内物体交互
种植时自动选择土壤和种子

entries.Original: Automatically confirms the lower quality popup menu.
entries.Translated: 自动确认降低物品品质的弹窗。

entries.Original: Automatically consumes a Gysahl Green in the overworld if you don't have your chocobo out.
entries.Translated: 在野外尚未召出搭档陆行鸟时，自动使用基萨尔野菜。

entries.Original: Automatically draws motifs when outside of combat and not in a sanctuary.
entries.Translated: 在休息区以外且脱离战斗时自动绘画。

entries.Original: Automatically equip recommended gear upon job changing.
entries.Translated: 切换职业后自动穿戴推荐装备。

entries.Original: Automatically fill in gardening windows with seeds and soil.
entries.Translated: 自动在种植窗口填入种子和土壤。

entries.Original: Automatically give a commendation to a random player in your party at the end of a duty.
entries.Translated: 副本结束时，在队伍中随机选择一位玩家投最优队员票。

entries.Original: Automatically hits a button or mashes for you when the ATM is on screen.
entries.Translated: 出现紧急操作界面时，自动按键或连续按键。

entries.Original: Automatically merge stacks of same items
entries.Translated: 自动合并相同物品的堆叠

entries.Original: Automatically opens the map to coordinates posted in chat.
entries.Translated: 自动打开地图并定位到聊天中发布的坐标。

entries.Original: Automatically reset enmity on target dummies if you do not perform an action after a specified amount of time.
entries.Translated: 对木人停止攻击达到设定时长后，自动重置仇恨。

entries.Original: Automatically summons your Fairy or Carbuncle upon switching to SCH or SMN respectively.
entries.Translated: 切换为学者时自动召唤小仙女，切换为召唤师时自动召唤宝石兽。

entries.Original: Automatically targets and switches your target to the nearest within your line of sight.
entries.Translated: 自动选中视野内最近的目标，必要时切换目标。

entries.Original: Automatically teleports to the nearest aetheryte to a map link posted in chat. Requires "Teleporter" plugin installed.
entries.Translated: 自动传送至聊天地图链接附近的以太之光。需要安装 Teleporter 插件。

entries.Original: Automatically try to pick all the keys, levers, and other thingymabobs. Also works to try and open doors and stuff. (VERY EXPERIMENTAL)
entries.Translated: 自动尝试拾取钥匙、操作拉杆、开门或与其他物件交互。（实验性功能）

entries.Original: Automatically use Meditation when out of combat.
entries.Translated: 脱离战斗时自动使用默想。

entries.Original: Automatically use a cordial when below a given threshold.
entries.Translated: 采集力低于设定阈值时自动使用强心剂。

entries.Original: Automatically uses sprint when in an area you are gaining rested experience, such as cities.
entries.Translated: 在城市等可积累休息经验的区域自动使用冲刺。

entries.Original: Congratulations! You have no more MSQ quests to complete.... for now!
entries.Translated: 恭喜！你暂时已完成当前所有主线任务。

entries.Original: Disable Known Glamours in Glamour Creation
entries.Translated: 投影台中已有的外观不可重复放入

entries.Original: Disable Starting Buffs on Nodes with Collectibles
entries.Translated: 遇到含收藏品的采集点时禁用起手增益

entries.Original: Disables items from being transferred to the glamour dresser if it already exists in it
entries.Translated: 投影台中已有同款物品时，阻止再次放入。

entries.Original: Don't Buff if Item Not Present
entries.Translated: 目标物品不存在时不使用增益

entries.Original: Enable rapid fire button presses on controller by holding down a button.
entries.Translated: 按住手柄按钮时连续触发按键。
临危受命目标选择模式

entries.Original: For quickly linking multiple gearsets to a glamour plate.
entries.Translated: 用于将多套套装快速关联到投影套装。
战斗不能多少次后排除？

entries.Original: In the Diadem, this will remember the last slot selected and not the last item due to the varying nature of the nodes.
entries.Translated: 云冠群岛的采集点内容会变化，因此会记住所选栏位，而非上一次采集的物品。
长时间无操作时重置木人仇恨

entries.Original: Interacts with gathering nodes when close enough and on the correct job.
entries.Translated: 使用相应采集职业且距离足够近时，与采集点交互。

entries.Original: It's like the other item link commands, but allows searching.
entries.Translated: 可像其他物品链接命令一样使用，并支持搜索。

entries.Original: Mounts on zone change if not already mounted.
entries.Translated: 切换区域时自动骑乘（已骑乘时跳过）。

entries.Original: Mounts upon finishing gathering from a node. Will try to execute for up to 3 seconds after the delay if moving.
entries.Translated: 完成当前采集点的采集后自动骑乘。如果正在移动，会在延迟结束后的 3 秒内持续尝试。
在剪贴板中保留地图链接

entries.Original: Preserves the formatting for map links so they can be interacted with after pasting.
entries.Translated: 保留地图链接的格式，使粘贴后的链接仍可点击。

entries.Original: Prevents the Command Panel from closing during load screens.
entries.Translated: 切换区域加载时保持指令面板打开。

entries.Original: Prints a message in chat with how many main scenario quests left in the current expansion you have to complete.
entries.Translated: 在聊天栏中显示当前资料片剩余的主线任务数量。

entries.Original: Raise the display limit from 50 to the 100 limit actually allowed by the game.
entries.Translated: 将显示上限从 50 条提高至游戏实际支持的 100 条。

entries.Original: Refreshes the Party Finder at set intervals
entries.Translated: 按设定的时间间隔刷新招募板
在采集点之间记住所选物品

entries.Original: Replaces the Quick Gather checkbox with a new one that enables better quick gathering. Works on all nodes and can be interrupted at any point by disabling the checkbox. Also remembers your settings between sessions.
entries.Translated: 使用增强的快速采集开关替换原复选框。适用于所有采集点，可随时取消勾选来中断采集，设置会保留至下次登录。

entries.Original: Replaces the Trade button on the collectables interface with a Trade All button for the selected collectable.
entries.Translated: 将收藏品界面的交纳按钮替换为全部交纳按钮，适用于选中的收藏品。

entries.Original: Resets combat with target dummies. Accepts arguments for t(arget) or a(ll). Defaults to all.
entries.Translated: 结束与木人的战斗。参数 t 表示当前目标，a 表示全部，默认全部。
向陆行鸟鞍囊存入相同种类的物品

entries.Original: Searches feature names and descriptions for a given word or phrase.
entries.Translated: 在功能名称和说明中搜索指定的词句。
设置 <flag> 时不打开地图

entries.Original: Sets the Yes button on Yes/No prompts to automatically be enabled if normally a checkbox needed checked.
entries.Translated: 需要先勾选复选框才能点击“是”时，自动启用该按钮。

entries.Original: Sets the default amount for items to buy from vendors
entries.Translated: 设置从商店购买物品的默认数量。

entries.Original: Sets the default tab in the grand company menu when you open it.
entries.Translated: 设置打开军队菜单时默认显示的页签。

entries.Original: Switches to the appropriate gathering job when approaching a gathering spot and you have both Triangulate & Prospect active. Must have a gearset for the job to switch to.
entries.Translated: 同时开启三角测量和矿脉勘探时，靠近采集点将自动切换到相应职业。须事先保存该职业的套装。

entries.Original: Syncs when entering a FATE if you're overlevelled.
entries.Translated: 角色等级过高时，进入临危受命范围后自动同步等级。

entries.Original: This node contains quest nodes which can result in soft-locking the quest. Pandora Gathering has been disabled.
entries.Translated: 当前采集点含任务专用内容，继续自动采集可能导致任务无法推进。已关闭 Pandora 采集。

entries.Original: This will stop Pandora from using any actions when you start a node with a collectible on it. This is intended to prevent wasting GP on buffs that don't apply to collectibles.
entries.Translated: 开始采集时，若该采集点含有收藏品，将禁止 Pandora 使用任何技能，以免对收藏品无效的增益浪费采集力。

entries.Original: Try Interact Method 1 (interacts with most things)
entries.Translated: 尝试交互方式 1（适用于多数对象）

entries.Original: Try Interact Method 2 (interacts with things method 1 doesn't)
entries.Translated: 尝试交互方式 2（用于方式 1 无法交互的对象）

entries.Original: Try Interact with Both Methods (buggy on many things, use with caution)
entries.Translated: 尝试两种交互方式（与多种对象交互时可能出错，请谨慎使用）

entries.Original: Unset Target if not in cone range (all times, use with caution)
entries.Translated: 目标在扇形范围以外时取消选中（始终生效，请谨慎使用）

entries.Original: Unset Target if not in cone range (only in combat)
entries.Translated: 目标在扇形范围以外时取消选中（仅战斗中）

entries.Original: Use whilst walk status is toggled
Uses Peloton automatically outside of combat. (Physical Ranged only)
entries.Translated: 在战斗外自动使用速行，仅限远程物理职业。

entries.Original: Uses an Item from your inventory.
Using a macro with /mount in it will skip that line if you're already mounted
entries.Translated: 已骑乘时，执行包含 /mount 的宏会跳过该行。

entries.Original: Walk up to a chest to automatically open it. (Does not work with Deep Dungeon chests)
entries.Translated: 靠近宝箱时自动开启。（对深层迷宫宝箱无效）

entries.Original:
When enabled, this will select the first soil/seed found in your inventory if the
primary ones chosen are not found.
entries.Translated:
找不到首选土壤或种子时，
使用背包中的第一份土壤或种子。

entries.Original: When in a FATE and able to participate (synced), automatically targets FATE associated enemies.
entries.Translated: 参与临危受命且等级已同步时，自动选中相关敌人。

entries.Original: When switching to FSH, ensures Collector's Glove will always be on.
entries.Translated: 切换为捕鱼人时，确保开启收藏品采集。

entries.Original: When switching to MIN or BTN, automatically activate the other jobs searching ability.
entries.Translated: 切换至采矿工或园艺工时，自动开启另一职业的采集点探测技能。

entries.Original: When you open your inventory, the plugin will try and pull all stacks of the same item together.
entries.Translated: 打开背包时，插件会尝试将同种物品堆叠到一起。

entries.Original: Whenever you click a Party Finder listing, this will bypass the description window and auto click the join button.
entries.Translated: 点击招募条目时，跳过详情窗口并自动加入队伍。

entries.Original: Whenever you have to select an item to turn in, it will automatically fill in the interface.
entries.Translated: 需要选择交纳物品时，自动将物品填入交纳栏。

entries.Original: You are not in a duty to leave.
entries.Translated: 当前不在副本中，无法退出。
